# contentDirection and contentFrame where the system's answers the zero case and a zero rectangle, and a
# numeric axis' copy answered the scale where the system's answers the linear case. The family carries
# the system's behaviour, so the port's copies now drop the same three value-typed fields, and there is
# The mechanism stays: compare.py reads this file, and a row added to it has to carry what the system
# answers, what the port answers and why - the last column is not optional, and the reader fails without
# it. What pins those three answers is not a declaration but three mutants, one per field, each of which
# puts the field back into the port's copy and has to turn the case red on that one line. A declared
# difference cannot fail that way: a port that quietly started agreeing with the host passed a
